title: Dazzle-Doodling Cuttlefish
statement: This palm-sized cuttlefish paints its skin with shifting doodles — stars, spirals, and polka dots — as it explores a sun-dappled reef of purple kelp, tinkling shells, and cozy hidey-holes. Incurably curious, it will drift to the glass to invent a brand-new pattern just for you.
